args.title: Brightline Freight: freight pricing this quarter — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the latest Brightline Freight newsletter, its linked article (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/freight), and the article's companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/freight/companion):

• This quarter's freight market: spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady (newsletter topic: "Freight pricing this quarter"; a related webinar is also being offered).
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, meaning surcharge costs will adjust more frequently with the diesel market.
• Cost strategy: shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least, suggesting carrier diversification lowers freight spend.
